normal.text: #FFIX #VideoGames I went around the entire Forgotten Continent, thinking there was a mountain terrain from the sea to the continent to gain access with Choco. Nope. No idea how to get to it when the Chocograph says all you need are the field, reef, mountain and sea abilities. So I try to consult a guide. Or ten. Not a single one of them mentions that you do need a flying ship to get to the continent even with the chocobo. FFS…

normal.text: Oh, also putting a few minutes into actually good newer games has been nice. - Die for the Economy (Berserk'em up) - Look Outside (pseudo Earthbound horror) - Devil Engine (sh'mup) - Byte Driver (if SE Qld's afternoon danger traffic was a Vectrex racing game) - The Horror of Salazar House (dos horror with a ton of schlock and references) All very good and different. normal.name: Marcus Adams
normal.text: So AMD FSR is finally good enough for me. #Bazzite has added the FSR 4 flag by default now if you use a compatible version of Proton and GPU, so even if a game doesn't "say" FSR4 in its settings, FSR 3.1 gets auto upgraded to FSR 4 at a driver level with the latest Proton GE on Bazzite. I've tinkered with FSR in the past and it always just looked bad; weird grainy artifacts, particle effects being butchered or erased, etc. But FSR 4 is really good, like native resolution good. #Gaming #PCGaming
